test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 12 Sept, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Six people, Vijay, Harsh, Golu, Satish, Karan and Awadhi are sitting in a straight line, facing north.

Vijay sits 3rd from the right end. Harsh sits 3rd to the left of Vijay. Satish is an immediate neighbour of Harsh. Golu sits 3rd to the right of Satish. Awadhi is an immediate neighbour of Golu.

Who sits 2nd to the right of Vijay?
solution:
According to the given information,

1) Vijay sits 3rd from the right end. Harsh sits 3rd to the left of Vijay.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3bd1a6b0967c3a5447e71c2008348ef2e6e520f8eee81e74557bf536d844f734.png] 

2) Satish is an immediate neighbour of Harsh.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b75a22cf5c5e089617affe446a3d892756496850d943acfd8b4cef0d9f8275c4.png] 

3) Golu sits 3rd to the right of Satish. Awadhi is an immediate neighbour of Golu.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/09612a2888e3df04857801e3dd10f5ccd6d0d85146a0b97b4e44b19e3792431a.png] 

Here, we can see that Awadhi sits 2nd to the right of Vijay.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Awadhi"**.
